يحيى بن الحسن بن جعفر بن عبيد الله بن الحسين

notes: Ruling (rule 11): inside Fadl's words the Imam (علي بن موسى) speaks and acts in a narrated encounter; not added as a link (rule 6)
«أخبرني جدي يحيى» : «جدي» plus a name is one link, surface the name alone (rule 7)
«محمد بن جعفر» is in the scene (with Musa in Khurasan), not a link
«- ...» the leading «6 -» is a report number: left out
Fadl ibn Sahl is a link because Musa reports «سمعت أن ذا الرئاستين ... خرج وهو يقول»

fixes.reason: The nisba and the name of the transmitter run together with no space in the printed text, so the surface is kept as printed
